description:
Sony's new animated film has a lot of ambition, but is it up there with Spider-Verse and K-Pop Demon Hunters? Doug gives his thoughts on, GOAT.

Come see Doug & Brad March 13th-15th - https://gameonexpo.com/

Watch the new Nostalgia Critic - https://youtu.be/_AOn1KPxsNk

Check out our store - https://channelawesome.myshopify.com/

Goat (stylized in all caps) is a 2026 American animated sports comedy film produced by Columbia Pictures and Sony Pictures Animation. Directed by Tyree Dillihay and written by Aaron Buchsbaum and Teddy Riley, Caleb McLaughlin stars as Will Harris, an anthropomorphic goat who aspires to become the greatest of all time at a basketball-like sport known as roarball. The ensemble voice cast also includes Gabrielle Union, Aaron Pierre, Nicola Coughlan, David Harbour, Nick Kroll, Jenifer Lewis, Patton Oswalt, Jelly Roll, Jennifer Hudson, Sherry Cola, Eduardo Franco, Andrew San
